''Les Audoniens'' (The [[Saint-Ouen-sur-Seine|Audonians]]) | shortname = | founded = {{Start date and age|df=yes|1897|2|21}} | stadium = [[Stade Bauer]] | capacity = 5,600 | chairman = Patrice Haddad | chrtitle = President | owner = A-CAP | mgrtitle = Head coach | manager = [[Damien Perrinelle]] | league = {{French football updater|Red Star}} | season = {{French football updater|Red Star2}} | position = {{French football updater|Red Star3}} | website = {{URL|https://www.redstar.fr}} | pattern_la1 = _RedStar2425h | pattern_b1 = _RedStar2425h | pattern_ra1 = _RedStar2425h | leftarm1 = FFFFFF | body1 = FFFFFF | rightarm1 = FFFFFF | shorts1 = 0C6646 | socks1 = 0C6646 | pattern_la2 = _RedStar2425a | pattern_b2 = _RedStar2425a | pattern_ra2 = _RedStar2425a | leftarm2 = 124940 | body2 = 124940 | rightarm2 = 124940 | shorts2 = FFFFFF | socks2 = FFFFFF | pattern_la3 = _RedStar2425t | pattern_b3 = _RedStar2425t | pattern_ra3 = _RedStar2425t | leftarm3 = 8A3840 | body3 = 8A3840 | rightarm3 = 8A3840 | shorts3 = 000000 | socks3 = 000000 | current = 2024–25 Red Star F.C. season }} '''Red Star Football Club''' ({{IPA|fr|ʁɛd staʁ futbol klœb}}), commonly referred to as '''Red Star FC''' or simply '''Red Star''', is a French professional [[association football|football]] club founded in [[Paris]] in 1897. The club plays its home matches at the [[Stade Bauer]].{{cite web |date=22 May 2019 |title=Red Star: En National au stade Bauer (off) |url=http://www.foot-national.com/foot-red-star-en-national-au-stade-bauer-off-118231.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190526211452/http://www.foot-national.com/foot-red-star-en-national-au-stade-bauer-off-118231.html |archive-date=26 May 2019 |access-date=13 June 2019 |website=Foot-national.com |language=fr}} They currently compete in [[Ligue 2]], the second tier of [[Football in France|French football]], having been promoted from the third tier [[Championnat National]] at the end of the [[2023–24 Championnat National|2023–24 season]]. The club is the fourth oldest football club in France after [[Standard AC]] of Paris,{{Cite web|url=https://www.fff.fr/la-vie-des-clubs/177099/infos-cles|title=Fédération Française de Football|access-date=18 October 2021|archive-date=26 February 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240226133500/https://www.fff.fr/|url-status=live}} [[Le Havre AC]] and [[Girondins de Bordeaux]]. Despite the club's long spell under a [[Semi-professional sports|semi-pro]] status, Red Star has a rich history. The club was founded in 1897 under the name ''Red Star Club Français'' by French football legend [[Jules Rimet]]. Rimet later went on to serve as president of both the [[French Football Federation]] and [[FIFA]]. The [[FIFA World Cup Trophy#Jules Rimet Trophy|original FIFA World Cup Trophy]] was named in his honour. Red Star was one of the founding member clubs of [[Ligue 1]] and has spent 19 seasons in the first division; the club's last top tier stint being in [[1974–75 French Division 1|1974–75]]. In cup competitions, the club has won five [[Coupe de France]] titles, which is tied for fifth-best among all French clubs. While the club have enjoyed only modest success on the field, the club is widely recognised for its distinctive social culture. Red Star supporters are strongly identified with their support of [[left-wing politics]], [[social activism]] and a party atmosphere they create at the club's matches.{{Cite news |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/in-bed-with-maradona/2018/jan/20/red-star-football-club-paris-jules-rimet-david-bellion |title=Red Star: the oldest, hippest and most political football club in Paris |first=Mark |last=Godfrey |date=20 January 2018 |newspaper=[[The Guardian]] |access-date=7 January 2020 |archive-date=19 August 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200819231351/https://www.theguardian.com/football/in-bed-with-maradona/2018/jan/20/red-star-football-club-paris-jules-rimet-david-bellion |url-status=live }} The club was purchased by US-based private investment firm [[777 Partners]] in May 2022, a move which saw demonstrations from fans leading to the postponement of a Championnat National match in April 2022.{{cite web|url=https://www.footamateur.fr/national-le-red-star-officiellement-vendu-au-fond-americain-777-partners/|title=National. The Red Star v Sète abandoned due to projectiles being thrown|publisher=footamateur.fr|language=fr|date=15 April 2022|access-date=13 May 2022|archive-date=16 April 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220416214924/https://www.footamateur.fr/national-la-rencontre-red-star-sete-arretee-pour-jets-de-projectiles/|url-status=live}} In August 2026, 777 Partners filed for [[Chapter 11 bankruptcy]] in an effort to eliminate the majority of its $2 billion debt.{{Cite web|url= https://www.law360.com/bankruptcy-authority/articles/2511636/investment-firm-777-partners-hits-ch-11-to-handle-2b-debt|title= Investment Firm 777 Partners Hits Ch. 11 To Handle $2B+ Debt|first=Clara|last=Geoghegan|date=2026-08-10|access-date=2026-08-10|website=Law360|language=en}}"}}
